description: Use this when someone asks which of their credit or debit cards to pay with at a shop, app, category or city, to get the most cashback. Pass the place (a merchant such as Grab or Shopee, a category such as dining or supermarket, or a city such as Tokyo, or both: 'dining in Tokyo') and the cards they hold (names or ids). It answers in one line, 'use card X here, because Y, up to cap Z', with the second-best card, each card's cap and conditions, and the bank source link. The data pack covers Vietnam-issued cards; amounts are in VND.

amount.description: Purchase amount, in VND unless currency says otherwise. Default 1,000,000 VND.

cards.description: The cards the person holds, by name ('VPBank Z JCB') or id ('vpbank-z-jcb').

channel.description: Online or in a shop, when the place alone does not say.

currency.description: ISO code of amount when the person gives a foreign amount, such as JPY for 8,000 yen. The tool converts at its own dated rate; do not convert yourself.

date.description: Purchase date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today in Vietnam.

picks.description: Bonus categories picked on pick-N cards, by group (vib-one, vib-max, cake-freedom, msb-mdigi).

place.description: Merchant, category or city, for example 'Grab', 'supermarket', 'dining in Tokyo'.

statement_spend.description: Spend so far this statement by card id, for minimum spend and tiers.

name: pick_card
title: Which card to tap here
